summary: Handle duplicate ticket_already_exists and terminal reconciliation errors per-ticket in inbound sync

delivery.outcome: Prevent single-ticket pre-existing ID or active-lease reconciliation errors from aborting entire repository inbound GitHub sync runs.
nonGoals: Relaxing expected_absent=True protection against concurrent writers in PlanfileStore.

architecture.decision: Resolve pre-existing generated IDs across loaded sections in _process_external_ticket and handle inbound_terminal_transition_requires_execution_reconciliation per-ticket without aborting the batch.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching planfile/sync/operations.py and tests/test_sync_inbound_resilience.py.

validation.evidence: Both new resilience tests and existing concurrency protection tests pass; governance-check passes.
